title: chore: replace codesandbox ci with pkg.pr.new
body:
## Summary

* Codesandbox CI is shutting down — replace it with [pkg.pr.new](https://github.com/stackblitz-labs/pkg.pr.new)
* Added GitHub Actions workflow that publishes preview packages and generates StackBlitz previews on every PR
* Removed `.codesandbox/ci.json`
